raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: Misinterpretation of the temporal context and the definition of "quadrennial election." The agent incorrectly identified the 2020 election as the 58th quadrennial election. In reality, the 2016 election was the 58th quadrennial election (the sequence began in 1788/1789; 1788 is #1, 1792 is #2... 2016 is #58). The 2020 election is the 59th. The agent failed to correctly count the historical sequence of US presidential elections, leading to an incorrect final answer despite correctly identifying the date of the Michigan primary.
